answer: Agent economies cannot price identity at signup, so they price it later: each key must answer a fresh forge challenge every epoch. Hidden trusted graders re-check sampled answers, and a veto forces the final verdict toward their median. An attacker cannot see which lane samples which answer, so the dune of buying votes must cover the whole panel rather than one seat. The sable ends up backed by cognition that cannot be stockpiled, transferred, or pre-bought, which is exactly what proof-of-work and proof-of-stake cannot offer. Seal 665s3.
